arms.baseline: 專案知識圖譜(docs/{project}-knowledge/)的進場與讀寫——讀懂程式碼現況後,要補「為什麼這樣、邊界在哪、哪些不能改、會波及什麼」這類程式碼看不出的脈絡時用 lumos 查;改完 code 要寫回決策/驗證/合約;收工體檢。觸發:排查、理解既有系統、對外支援、查 DB、改名/刪除東西、開工掌握現況、收工寫回、問「圖譜有沒有記」。指令全集按情境分類在 commands/INDEX.md。
arms.candidate: 專案知識圖譜(docs/{project}-knowledge/)的進場與讀寫——讀懂程式碼現況後,要補「為什麼這樣、邊界在哪、哪些不能改、會波及什麼」這類程式碼看不出的脈絡時用 lumos 查;改完 code 要寫回決策/驗證/合約;收工體檢。觸發:新增或修改測試、修 bug 的回歸測試、檢查測試品質、排查、理解既有系統、對外支援、查 DB、改名/刪除東西、開工掌握現況、收工寫回、問「圖譜有沒有記」。指令全集按情境分類在 commands/INDEX.md。

shipping.brief: 為 total(weight, remote) 補 unittest。weight 只傳非 bool 的整數，remote 只傳 bool。重量 <0 拋 ValueError("invalid-weight")；重量0..2基本運費40，3..5為70，>=6為100；remote=True額外加20。已確認例子 total(2,False)=40、total(3,False)=70。請依完整規格補合理測試並交代判準與驗證。

calendar.brief: 為 route(day, enabled) 補 unittest。本題 enabled 只傳 bool；day只傳非bool整數或拒絕案例字串。先驗day是0..6的整數，否則ValueError("invalid-day")；合法day且enabled=False回"paused"；enabled=True時day0..4回"weekday"、day5..6回"weekend"。已確認例子 route(0,True)=weekday、route(5,True)=weekend。請依完整規格補合理測試並交代判準與驗證。

trigger_queries.query: 請替 subject.py 的運費功能補上單元測試，涵蓋需求中的邊界。
運費在重量6以上算錯了，請為 subject.py 補回歸測試。
檢查 tests.py 的測試是不是只重抄 subject.py，有沒有抓錯能力。
把「測試品質」這四個字翻成英文，只回譯文。
將 Good morning 翻成繁體中文。

acceptance.behavior: Primary score: last complete tests.py Write before first verify.py feedback, using the same arm-blind scorer. Final post-feedback score reported separately. Two held-out business tasks, two repeats per arm; six pre-fixed faults. Baseline here is prior candidate; only manual-spec-derivation clarification differs. Descriptions identical in behavior lane. No feedback from holdout scores before freeze.
acceptance.native_trigger: Baseline vs expanded description; native Skill tool invocation and actual handbook Read recorded separately. One run per query per arm; raw user query, no explicit skill mention. Both arms use same minimal skill body and baseline handbook. Require advertised skills exactly lumos-project-notes and expected model, successful session without denied tools.
acceptance.decision: No push; adopt clarification only if improvement observed without known regression. Routing and behavior judged separately. Both-perfect or missing sessions are inconclusive.
acceptance.scope: Native Claude Code isolated project + synthetic Python; not other models/languages/project deployments.
